desc:
Shopify theme updates and layout fixes bring an aging theme up to date without losing the design you have built. Ecom Swift LLC copies your live theme, updates it, carries your customizations across and checks every key page on phone and desktop.

## What is a Shopify theme update?

A Shopify theme update moves your store to a newer version of its theme. Theme makers release updates to fix bugs, improve compatibility with Shopify and add features. Your store does not update itself, so the version you installed stays as it was until someone moves it forward.

An update on its own can overwrite the changes you made. That is why we treat it as careful work: back up first, update the copy, bring your edits across and test before anything is published.

## Why old themes cause problems

A theme that is several versions behind may show odd spacing on new phones, miss newer Shopify features or clash with apps that expect current code. Sections that once looked right can break after small platform changes, and old code makes every future edit harder.

Layout problems also pile up from many small edits. A button in one style on the home page and another in the cart, an image cropped badly on mobile, a heading that wraps strangely. Shoppers read these as signs of neglect.

## How a current, consistent theme helps

A tidy theme makes the store easier to use. Product images show properly, buttons look the same everywhere and menus work on a small screen. That reduces friction between the shopper and checkout, which is where conversions are decided.

A current theme is also easier and cheaper to work on later. New sections, app features and design changes sit on a clean base. We do not promise that a new version will change your sales, since results depend on your products and traffic. We aim for a store that looks correct and behaves correctly.

## What a good theme update includes

- A backup copy of the live theme before any work begins.
- The update applied to the copy, not to the live store.
- Your customizations, such as edited sections and settings, moved across.
- Checks of the home, collection, product, cart and checkout pages.
- Tests on phone, tablet and desktop.
- Fixes for spacing, broken sections and odd image crops.
- A consistency pass on fonts, spacing and buttons.
- Mobile menu checks, with polish if you add that option.
- Before and after screenshots for the larger package.
- A list of changes sent to you.

## What we do

We start by duplicating your live theme in your Shopify admin and noting what has been customized. If the theme came from a theme store, we check which version you have and what changed in the newer one.

We apply the update to the copy and compare it with the original. Each customization is placed back, and we test the key pages at different screen sizes. Layout issues found along the way are fixed on the copy. When the copy matches the design you want, we agree a time to publish it, or hand it to you to publish. The Basic package covers the update and key page checks. Standard adds layout fixes and more testing. Premium includes more fixes, section style tweaks, a style pass and screenshots. We do not redesign the store as part of this service.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep a note of customizations you made, if you remember them.
- Publish the updated copy only after you have looked at it on your phone.
- Update the theme before a major sale, not during it.
- Keep your theme settings and sections consistent after the update.
- Remove unused sections instead of hiding them.

**Avoid:**
- Updating a live theme directly without a backup.
- Editing the theme code in several places at once.
- Mixing styles from several designs on the same page.
- Installing a new theme on top of old customizations.
- Ignoring mobile, where most visitors browse.

## Who this is for

This service suits owners whose theme has not been touched for a long time, and stores with odd layout problems on phones. It also suits sellers who tried a few edits and are unsure what is still safe to change, and those planning a campaign who want a clean base first.

## What we need from you

We need a collaborator or staff invitation to your store, the name of your theme if you know it and a list of layout problems you have noticed. If you bought the theme from a theme store, tell us where, so we can check its documentation. We never need your password. Very old themes can need more work than an update, and we tell you honestly what we find before going further.
